description: Frontend route prefix → allowed roles. Keep src/routes/routeRoleMap.js in sync with this file.

notes.unlistedAuthenticatedRoutes: Token-only (any authenticated role): /payment/return, /payment-success, /payment-failure, /profile. API 401/403 remain the source of truth.
notes.roleSource: user.role from login payload stored in Redux/localStorage; never invent roles client-side.
notes.matching: Longest prefix wins: pathname === prefix or pathname.startsWith(prefix + '/').
